name: Tagliatelle al Pomodoro
tagline: Fresh egg tagliatelle, slow-simmered tomato, basil, parmesan.

preparation.title: Roll the pasta
preparation.description: Egg tagliatelle is rolled and cut fresh in-house.

preparation.title: Boil
preparation.description: Dropped into rolling, salted water until al dente.

preparation.title: Drain & plate
preparation.description: Drained and plated immediately to preserve texture.

preparation.title: Toss in sauce
preparation.description: Tossed through a slow-simmered San Marzano tomato sauce.

preparation.title: Finish
preparation.description: Topped with fresh basil and shaved parmesan.

discover.chefNotes: The sauce simmers for four hours before service. We taste it every thirty minutes -- that's the only way to know it's ready.
facts: Tagliatelle's ribbon width is said to have been inspired by the golden hair of Lucrezia Borgia.
Bologna's chamber of commerce keeps an official, legally registered tagliatelle recipe.
Traditionally made with just eggs and flour, no water.
discover.culturalBackground: Fresh egg pasta is a cornerstone of Emilia-Romagna's cuisine, historically rolled by hand (la sfoglia) as a daily household ritual passed between generations.
